bio: See some of Cumbria's most beautiful areas with this wonderful trip on a diesel or steam pulled train. Take in views of the Lake District and then enjoy a Cream Tea for two.  Enjoy a wonderful day taking in some of Britain's most beautiful landscapes with this fantastic train experience. You'll enjoy a delightfully lazy seven-mile journey through the stunning Cumbria countryside in a steam pulled train, travelling down the Eskdale Valley from coastal Ravenglass to the foot of the Scafell Mountains and back.  What's more, you'll also receive a tasty cream tea at Dalegarth Station. Tuck into an assortment of sandwiches and fluffy scones with tea or coffee.
